hypotheses.name: Batch parallel tool calls in a single turn
hypotheses.rationale: Trace analysis shows ~30% of multi-step scenarios issue 3+ independent tool calls serially. Batching them into one turn cuts wall-time without changing the agent's reasoning surface. Anthropic-published evidence: parallel tool calls reduce latency 2-3x with no quality regression on independent calls.
hypotheses.risk: If the agent batches calls with hidden dependencies (search-then-fetch where the URL comes from the search) the batch fails and the retry costs more than serial. Validator must include scenarios with dependent tool sequences.

treatment.append: When you need to call multiple INDEPENDENT tools in a turn, issue them in parallel. Only serialize when the next call depends on the previous result.
